[[Sun Belt Conference|Sun Belt]] regular season champions |tourney=[[2019 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] |tourney_result = First Round }} {{2018–19 Sun Belt Conference men's basketball standings}} The '''2018–19 Georgia State Panthers men's basketball team''' represented [[Georgia State University]] during the [[2018–19 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The team's head coach was [[Ron Hunter]], who coached his eighth and final season at Georgia State. The Panthers played their home games at the [[GSU Sports Arena]] in [[Atlanta|Atlanta, Georgia]] as a member of the [[Sun Belt Conference]]. Finishing with a 13–5 conference record, GSU won its third Sun Belt regular season championship in the last six years. The Panthers defeated [[2018–19 Texas State Bobcats men's basketball team|Texas State]], and [[2018-19 UT Arlington Mavericks men's basketball team|UT Arlington]] to become champions of the [[2019 Sun Belt Conference men's basketball tournament|Sun Belt tournament]]. As a result, they received the Sun Belt's automatic bid to the [[2019 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] where they lost to [[2018–19 Houston Cougars men's basketball team|Houston]] in the first round. == Previous season == The Panthers finished the season 24–11, 12–6 in Sun Belt play to finish the regular season in second place. The Panthers defeated [[2017–18 Troy Trojans men's basketball team|Troy]], [[2017–18 Georgia Southern Eagles men's basketball team|Georgia Southern]], and [[2017–18 Texas–Arlington Mavericks men's basketball team|UT Arlington]] to become champions of the [[2018 Sun Belt Conference men's basketball tournament|Sun Belt tournament]]. As a result, they received the Sun Belt's automatic bid to the [[2018 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]]. As the No. 15 seed in the West region, they lost to [[2017–18 Cincinnati Bearcats men's basketball team|Cincinnati]] in the first round. ==Offseason== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
